prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: horizontal editorial cover photograph for a Spanish publication about AI and work
Primary request: two independent hardware tinkerers in a small community workshop inspecting a compact computer board together, a human scene about open tools, collaboration and new AI systems.
Scene/backdrop: practical maker workshop with soldering iron, repair tools and components; no visible screens, no printed text.
Style/medium: candid photojournalism, believable working hands and imperfect surfaces, subtle 35mm film grain.
Composition/framing: cinematic 16:9 landscape, one person holds the board while another studies it, foreground details sharp.
Lighting/mood: low workshop light with one restrained red task lamp reflected on the board, curious and collaborative.
Color palette: warm near-black, muted metal, natural skin tones, restrained red accent.
Constraints: no text, logo or watermark.
Avoid: office, paper, documents, computer screens, robots, sci-fi glow, posed tech stock photography.
